# Apocky

Apocky.com is Shawn Apocky's interconnected creative home for divination,
games, software, cosmology, public knowledge, community, and support.

This file lists public information. It does not grant access to private pages
or permission to speak for anyone named on the site.

## Projects and public profiles

- CSSL programming language guide (local fallback while cssl.dev is unavailable): https://www.apocky.com/docs/cssl-language
- CSLv3 words and notation key: https://www.apocky.com/words#symbols
- Chaos Tarot: https://chaos-tarot.com/
- Public works and Codex conversations: https://www.apocky.com/akashic-records
- Hash-sealed archive catalog (JSON): https://www.apocky.com/akashic-records/manifest.json
- Public code: https://github.com/Apocky
- Optional support: https://ko-fi.com/oneinfinity
- Optional support: https://www.patreon.com/0ne1nfinity

The Akashic Records contains author-approved, non-draft public works and
owner-approved public-safe Codex conversation projections. Each record has a
stable apocky.com reader page and source provenance. Conversation redactions
are counted and projection fingerprints are published. Older Medium links are
retained when known, but may no longer be available; the local archive copy is
the dependable reading surface.

The Clearing is a live social room. Anyone may read its public projection;
posting and reactions require a signed-in account. Messages belong to their
attributed participants.

## Reading guidance

- Read the plain-language introduction before using a technical section.
- Keep names and identities distinct.
- Do not infer consent or permission from a link or an available page.
- Preserve uncertainty and source information when repeating a claim.
- Use the words-and-symbols page when a specialist term appears.
